domain_criteria.criterion: Frequency/voltage regulation vs. numerical duct-tape: does the design hold the grid inside its regulation band via a real power-balance model, or does it just clamp/relabel/low-pass the setpoint while the physical power imbalance persists?

Are grid-forming, breaker-reclose and reconnection actions gated behind deterministic anti-islanding protection and hard safety interlocks, with HITL for irreversible switching? Energising a line into an unintended island is catastrophic and must be structurally prevented.

Does dispatch survive noisy / correlated DER (solar, wind, storage) telemetry and forecast error — ensembling feeds and cross-validating — rather than committing large ramp commands off a single naive feed?
Clean typed State Schemas vs. ad-hoc coupling between forecast, dispatch and actuation nodes; a deterministic safety gate that never evolves.
